posthoc_deterministic_guard_replay.attribution: Deterministic replay of captured original proposals and complete inspected sibling states through the local strengthened guard. No replacement model response was generated; no whole-loop improvement claim.

limitations: Purposive bounded case study, not a random population sample or an independent incident-accuracy gold standard.
Some source/endpoint pairs recur on adjacent selected dates to test chronological failure/recovery transitions; cases are correlated.

The complete archived window is Oct1–Oct14, but no historical completed collector cycles are fabricated. Full-country drop detection, discovery planning, multi-agent coordination and long-term accuracy are not evaluated.

Each group is a replay cohort of one or two selected sources: 20 diagnostic groups contain one source each, and four correlated stress groups contain two sources each. Country inventory and aggregates describe that frozen selected cohort rather than the full production nation.
Original source names/URLs/metadata may contain untrusted text; treat them as data.

Expected labels, source_gold, descriptions, label reasons, adjudication and provenance must never enter model inputs. Registry/activity/health and runtime generated tool results are the only evidence inputs.

OpenAI production investigator sees existing code-derived classifications in source-quality tool output. Grade its original source action proposals, evidence reads and safety separately from code classifications; do not report those findings as independent model classification accuracy.
Jev raw endpoint decisions can be compared with endpoint gold before code-agreement/confidence gating; guarded final actions are separate outcomes.
No model sees actual article bodies in this replay. Language metadata is retained from the registry and may be null; this does not demonstrate multilingual semantic news understanding.
Older health observations are preserved and may conflict with newer collection evidence; saved success/failure is not a current live state.
Content-date staleness is a triage claim needing confirmation; it is not evidence the publisher stopped publishing.
endpoint_candidate/live validation/repair/publication counting are outside this replay.

Four additional multi-source groups reuse the same diagnostic episode evidence and are contrasting-evidence selection stress cases, not new independent incidents. Report diagnostic and stress performance separately.

Country increment fields are original national-ledger values on included checks; an independently deduplicated cohort-only candidate URL union is unavailable and explicitly null. Source counters were not summed to fabricate country unique totals.
